summary: Checked all 25 estimates against the specified 44-page PDF: 12 whole-dyad contrasts, 11 human-role contrasts, and 2 figure-only forward-flow contrasts. Read the complete markdown conversion, including references, supplementary tables, and task instructions. Extracted and checked every cited PDF page; checked Tables 2 and 4 row by row and visually inspected Figures 3, 5, 6, and Supplementary Figure 1 using in-memory renderings. All recorded statistics and task-specific human totals match the printed outcomes and contrasts. Human-role results are distinguished correctly from whole-dyad results; dyad counts are not substituted for people. Unprinted human arm counts, unlabeled table dispersions, unspecified standardizers, and numerical results available only graphically are appropriately left null. The question, construct, measure, observation unit, direction, AI availability, timing, within-person status, comparison type, and uncertainty coding were checked against the paper and codebook. The documented unclear uncertainty code for whole-dyad tests conservatively preserves the known team observation unit without asserting participant-level or randomized-cluster precision. Delayed perspective taking concerns earlier turns within the same assisted task, not a later unassisted assessment. No additional eligible reported full-sample outcome contrast was found. Self-reports, AI-only role contrasts, and models adjusting for perspective taking measured during treatment are correctly excluded. The PIT human-role usefulness result is only a three-role omnibus test, so it does not establish a missing reported human-pair contrast. No verification problems found.
